summary: Arcode reopens your file tabs on start, and gains a Restart item, an AutoSave switch, and code folding in notebook cells.
details: Open files and the active tab are saved and restored; New Arcode Window still starts empty.
AutoSave, off by default, saves a notebook 1 minute after an edit or output change.
Notebook cells fold long dicts, lists and functions.
Keyboard Shortcuts moved from the notebook toolbar to the Settings menu.
